Class FriendshipDBRepository

java.lang.Object
com.lab.repository.db.AbstractDBRepository<Tuple<Long,Long>, Friendship>
com.lab.repository.db.FriendshipDBRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
FriendshipPagingRepository, Repository<Tuple<Long,Long>, Friendship>
public class FriendshipDBRepository extends AbstractDBRepository<Tuple<Long,Long>, Friendship> implements FriendshipPagingRepository
Database repository implementation for Friendship entities Extends AbstractDBRepository and prepares the environment for JDBC persistence
